newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine port Necochea still closed due to swell.
newsitem.headline: Argentine port Necochea still closed due to swell.

text.p: One of Argentina's most important grain ports, Necochea, was still closed Monday due to a heavy swell, a port official said.
"It's still closed, the waves are 2.1 meters (6.9 feet) high," the official told Reuters.
He said that he was not sure how long the port would remain closed, but added that a dregder had begun work to clear silt from the port's main access channel.
Necochea officials said Friday, when the port was also closed, that nine ships were stuck in port and 20 were waiting to enter.
Argentine grain traders say that the delays are making it more difficult to clinch wheat and maize export sales.
